notablePrerequisites:
You control creatures that together can tap for at least {2} and didn't attack or enter this turn.
Gogo didn't enter this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, The Fifth Doctor triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying The Fifth Doctor's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The Fifth Doctor's trigger, untapping all creatures you control that didn't enter or attack this turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 2.
